detail_list.name: Limnobium laevigatum
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Limnobium laevigatum from South America is a decorative floating plant that is particularly suitable for open aquariums.1-5 cm tall and leaves from 5-15 cm wide. It is also good in traditional aquariums, because the fine, long and decorative roots provide protection to gouramies and other surface fish that like the roots of floating plants. If there are enough nutrients in the water and the light intensity is good, new leaves will appear above the water surface. It may become necessary to remove some to avoid that the plants beneath it still gets some light. When the nutrient level in the water decreases, it will grow much slower which makes it a great indicator of the available nutrients.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。来自南美的南美沼萍是一种装饰性漂浮植物，适合开放式水族箱。高1-5 厘米，叶子宽5-15 厘米。它在传统水族箱中也很有用，因为细长且具有装饰性的根部可以为巨口鱼和其他喜欢漂浮植物根部的表层鱼类提供保护。如果水中养分充足，光照强度好，新叶就会露出水面。可能有必要移除一些，以避免其下方的植物仍然受到光照。当水中的养分水平降低时，它的生长速度会慢得多，这使其成为可用养分的重要指标。

detail_list.name: Limnophila aquatica
detail_list.introduction: An extremely beautiful aquarium plant circled by light-green and finely branched leaves from South-East Asia. In the right growing conditions with added CO2 and a nutritious bottom this plant grows fast and can become 25-50 cm long and each stem up to 15 cm wide. In good light it forms horizontal side shoots and becomes attractive and bushy. Most decorative when several stems are planted in a small group. In open aquariums it sometimes sends shoots above the water surface, forming small blue flowers.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 一种观赏性较强的水草，周围环绕着来自东南亚的浅绿色、细分枝的叶子。在适当的生长条件下，添加 CO₂和富含养分的底床，这种植物生长速度很快，可以长到 25-50 厘米，每根茎宽达 15 厘米。在光线充足的情况下，它会形成水平侧枝，变得有吸引力且浓密。当几根茎种植成一小群时，最具装饰性。在开放式水族箱中，它有时会将芽伸出水面，形成蓝色的小花。

detail_list.name: Limnophila hippuridoides
detail_list.introduction: Limnophila hippuridoides is originally from Asia and the stalks grow to be 20-50 cm high and 6-10 cm wide – often with beautiful outwards crooked shoot tips. A simple plant, able to adjust to various conditions. The leaves are green with a red-violet underside, and the whole leaf turns red-violet under ideal growth conditions. A vigorously growing plant that willingly creates new, solid shoots from the base. Thinning of the oldest and longest shoots is recommended, in order to make room for such new shoots. Replant the cut-offs, they will soon grow new roots. If either stem or leaves are damaged, a strong scent is emitted.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红宝塔原产于亚洲，茎高 20-50 厘米，宽 6-10 厘米，通常具有向外弯曲的芽尖。一个简单的植物，能够适应各种条件。叶子是绿色的，下面是红紫色的，在理想的生长条件下，整个叶子变成红紫色。一种生长旺盛的植物，愿意从基部长出新的、坚实的芽。建议疏除最老和最长的芽，以便为这些新芽腾出空间。重新种植剪下的根，它们很快就会长出新根。如果茎或叶受损，就会散发出强烈的气味。

detail_list.name: Limnophila sessiliflora
detail_list.introduction: Limnophila sessiliflora is a pretty and undemanding plant from South-East Asia. A great alternative to Cabomba, which doesn't requires a lot of light. Stems grow fast up to 40 cm tall and become 3-4 cm wide. The plant often grows leggy in poor light, but this can be counteracted to some extent by stimulating growth with CO2 addition. Most beautiful when planted in groups. In good growing conditions it sends out runners and spreads across the bottom. Limnophila sessiliflora used to be called "Ambulia''.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 小宝塔是一种来自东南亚的要求不高的植物。Cabomba 的绝佳替代品，不需要大量光线。茎生长迅速，高可达40 厘米，宽3-4 厘米。这种植物在光线不足的情况下通常会徒长，但通过添加 CO₂刺激生长可以在一定程度上抵消这种现象。成群种植时观赏效果最好。在良好的生长条件下，它会发出匍匐茎并沿底床蔓延。小宝塔过去被称为“Ambulia”。

detail_list.introduction: Lindernia rotundifolia 'Variegated' grows on sandy banks along streams in Asia. This marbled variant may grow new shoots with entirely green leaves. Cut these shoots off to maintain the marbled aspect. The plant is undemanding and quickly forms compact groups and may require some pruning.Lindernia rotundifolia is suitable both for background and as a solitary mid-ground plant with leaves growing tightly from top to bottom. A good starter plant that thrives under most conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 瓜子草“杂色”生长在亚洲溪流沿岸的沙岸上。这种大理石花纹的变种可能会长出带有全绿叶子的新芽。剪掉这些枝条以保持大理石般的外观。该植物要求不高，很快形成紧凑的群体，可能需要一些修剪。瓜子草既适合背景，也适合作为单独的中地植物，叶子从上到下紧密生长。一种良好的起始植物，在大多数条件下都能生长良好。

detail_list.name: Littorella uniflora
detail_list.introduction: The appearance of Littorella uniflora makes it an easily recognizable plant in the aquarium. It grows wild on lakeshores of Europe, North America and South America. Tolerates quite low light intensity, but this will add to the length of leaves. Each rosette is planted separately with a distance of a few cm. They will readily send out runners. In time a very characteristic carpet of fat and fleshy leaves – each 2-5 cm long and 0,1-0,3 cm wide – will be created. Be careful when maintaining the tank, the leaves are easily damaged. Littorella uniflora is suitable for terrarium and garden ponds, too.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 仙人掌草皮的外观使其成为水族箱中易于识别的植物。它野生生长于欧洲、北美和南美的湖畔。可以忍受相当低的光照强度，但这会增加叶子的长度。每个莲座丛以几厘米的距离分开种植。他们会很乐意派出走茎。随着时间的推移，将形成一张非常有特色的肥肉叶子草坪——每片叶子长 2-5 厘米，宽 0.1-0.3 厘米。维护水族箱时要小心，叶子很容易损坏。仙人掌草皮也适用于玻璃容器和花园池塘。

detail_list.name: Lobelia cardinalis
detail_list.introduction: Grown in a coconut fibre mini-pot to plug and grow in the tank. Packed in a breathable blister packaging to go. Lobelia cardinalis grows wild in Northern America. In the nursery this plant is cultivated in marshy conditions, forming dark-green leaves which are purple underneath. In aquariums the leaves turn a beautiful shade of light-green, with stems 10-30 cm tall and 5-10 cm wide. Widely used in Dutch aquariums in so-called "plant streets''. In open aquariums it grows above the water surface, where it forms very beautiful scarlet flowers and the leaves regain their colour. Can be used in garden ponds.

detail_list.name: Lobelia cardinalis 'Mini'
detail_list.introduction: Sometimes plants surprise by suddenly deviating from the way they normally grow. This is called a mutation, and Lobelia cardinalis ‘Mini’ is a good example of this. Lobelia cardinalis ‘Mini’ has thus originated from the general production of Lobelia cardinalis. It is characterized by its beautiful light green leaves which are closer together than on the original Lobelia, and then it is also significantly smaller, hence the addition ‘Mini’ to the name of the plant. The growth is low and dense, as the plant branches willingly, even without trimming. In addition, the mini version rarely forms the long vertical shoots which otherwise characterize Lobelia cardinalis. It is easily propagated by planting the cut shoots down into the bottom layer. Lobelia cardinalis ‘Mini’ becomes most compact in good light conditions and added CO2, but also thrives well without.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 有时，植物会因为突然偏离正常生长方式而感到惊讶。这称为突变，罗贝里 ‘Mini’ 就是一个很好的例子。罗贝里“Mini”因此起源于罗贝里的通用生产。它的特点是浅绿色叶子，叶子比原来的 Lobelia 更紧密，而且也明显更小，因此在植物名称中添加了“Mini”。生长低而茂密，即使不修剪，植物也会自动分枝。此外，迷你版很少形成罗贝里的特征的长垂直芽。通过将切下的枝条种植到底床，可以轻松繁殖。罗贝里“Mini”在良好的光照条件下变得最紧凑，并添加了 CO₂，但在没有 CO₂的情况下也能生长良好。

detail_list.name: Ludwigia glandulosa
detail_list.introduction: Ludwigia glandulosa from North America is a very beautiful water plant. It is slow growing and requires CO2 addition to grow well. Stems becomes 15-40 cm tall and 5-12 cm wide. The leaves turn greener and the lower ones may fall off if sufficient light is not provided.Used to be sold as Ludwigia perennis.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自北美的大红叶是一种观赏性较强的水草。它生长缓慢，需要添加 CO₂才能生长良好。茎高15-40 厘米，宽5-12 厘米。如果光照不足，叶子会变绿，下部叶子可能会脱落。以前以 Ludwigia perennis 的形式出售。

detail_list.name: Ludwigia palustris 'Green'
detail_list.introduction: This plant is a variation of Ludwigia palustris 'Super Red' and has the same form and needs as its parent. It is an easy and reliable stem plant. Each stalk grows 2-4 cm wide and 10-30+ cm high. The plant readily creates side shoots, and trimming increases the amount, making the plant even denser. The cut-off shoots quickly generate new roots when planted. An interesting effect can be created by planting 'Super Red' and 'Super Green' together in one group. The red and light green colors will enhance each other visually.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 该植物是超红水丁香的变种，与其亲本具有相同的形态和需求。它是一种简单可靠的有茎草。每根茎宽 2-4 厘米，高 10-30+ 厘米。植物很容易产生侧枝，修剪会增加侧枝数量，使植物更加茂密。被剪下的枝条在种植后很快就会长出新根。将“超级红”和“超级绿”种植在一组中可以产生有趣的效果。红色和浅绿色会在视觉上相互增强。

detail_list.name: Ludwigia palustris 'Super Red'
detail_list.introduction: This cosmopolitan stem plant turns red easier and is smaller than the well-known Ludwigia repens ’Rubin’. Each stalk becomes 2-4 cm wide and 10-30 cm high. The plant willingly creates side shoots, but cutting increases the amount and the plant becomes even denser. The cut-off shoots quickly generate new roots when planted. The plant becomes intensely red and grows better, when placed in light and with added CO2.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 这种国际化的有茎草更容易变红，而且比著名的鲁宾叶底红还要小。每根茎宽2-4 厘米，高10-30 厘米。植物容易长出侧枝，但修剪会增加侧枝数量，并且植物会变得更加密集。被剪下的枝条在种植后很快就会长出新根。当置于光照和添加 CO₂的情况下，植物会变成深红色，并且生长得更好。

detail_list.introduction_cn: 这种国际化的有茎草更容易变红，而且比著名的鲁宾叶底红还要小。每根茎宽2-4 厘米，高10-30 厘米。植物容易长出侧枝，但修剪会增加侧枝数量，并且植物会变得更加密集。被剪下的枝条在种植后很快就会长出新根。当置于光照和添加 CO₂的情况下，植物会变成深红色，并且生长得更好。

detail_list.name: Ludwigia repens 'Rubin'
detail_list.introduction: Variety of Ludwigia repens from North America with striking dark red leaves and stalk. Stems from 20-50 cm and 4-6 cm wide. It provides a great colour contrast to the green shades in the aquarium. Plant in large groups to enhance the decorative effect, and prune regularly to encourage bushy growth. The plant has few demands, but if light is insufficient the lower leaves tend to fall off. In strong light the colour becomes more intense.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Ludwigia 品种，来自北美，具有引人注目的深红色叶子和茎。茎长20-50 厘米，宽4-6 厘米。它与水族箱中的绿色色调形成了鲜明的色彩对比。大量种植以增强装饰效果，并定期修剪以促进浓密的生长。该植物对光照的要求不高，但如果光照不足，下部的叶子往往会脱落。在强光下颜色变得更浓。

detail_list.name: Lysimachia parvifolia ‘Red’
detail_list.introduction: Under simple aquarium conditions, Lysimachia parvifolia ‘Red’ already develops a reddish coloration. With improved lighting and good nutrient availability, the leaves become increasingly intense in colour, making it an attractive accent plant in the midground or background. The submerged leaves are small, rounded and resemble baby spinach, which is why the plant is sometimes referred to as Samolus parviflorus ‘Red’. The true Samolus parviflorus is a green aquarium plant with a very similar leaf shape, but Lysimachia parvifolia stands out due to its red hues. Growth is upright and compact when regularly trimmed, and the plant responds well to replanting of cut shoots. Stable conditions and a balanced nutrient supply ensure the best colour development. Outside the aquarium hobby, Lysimachia parvifolia has been used in Traditional Chinese Medicine as an anti-inflammatory herb.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 在简单的水族箱条件下，红小白菜已经呈现出微红色。随着光照的改善和良好的养分利用率，叶子的颜色变得越来越浓烈，使其成为中景或背景中观赏性较好的重点植物。淹没的叶子小而圆形，类似于小菠菜，这就是为什么这种植物有时被称为 Samolus parviflorus “红色”。真正的 Samolus parvifolius 是一种绿色水草，叶子形状非常相似，但 Lysimachia parvifolia 因其红色色调而较为醒目。定期修剪时，植物生长直立且紧凑，并且植物对剪下的芽重新种植反应良好。稳定的条件和均衡的营养供应确保了最佳的显色效果。除了水族箱爱好之外，Lysimachia 小叶在中药中也被用作抗炎草药。

detail_list.name: Marsilea hirsuta
detail_list.introduction: Marsilea hirsuta is a carpet-plant from Australia. A fascinating plant, usually delivered with leaves like a four-leaf clover. After a transitional period it develops different types of leaves, possibly a low form with single leaves like a large Glossostigma, or alternatively develop two, three or four-lobed leaves varying in height (from 2-10 cm), depending on the growth conditions. Whichever form the plant adopts, it forms runners and spreads rapidly round the aquarium.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 澳洲田字草是一家来自澳大利亚的草坪厂。一种颇具观赏性的植物，通常带有像四叶草一样的叶子。经过过渡期后，它会长出不同类型的叶子，可能是低矮的单叶叶子，如大的 Glossostigma，或者根据生长条件，长出不同高度（2-10 厘米）的两叶、三叶或四叶叶子。无论植物采用哪种形式，它都会形成跑者并在水族箱周围迅速蔓延。

detail_list.name: Marsilea minuta
detail_list.introduction: This small fern comes from Asia, where it often grows in rice fields. The leaves are tiny and rarely wider than 0.5 cm. A hardy plant that tolerates poor light conditions and high temperatures. However, improved conditions are beneficial to its development. Planted in small bundles that spread with offshoots. Creates a 1-3cm high and close carpet, well anchored in the bottom layer.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 这种小蕨类植物来自亚洲，通常生长在稻田中。叶子很小，宽度很少超过 0.5 厘米。一种耐寒的植物，可以忍受不良的光照条件和高温。但条件的改善有利于其发展。种植成小束，随枝条蔓延。创建 1-3 厘米高且紧密的草坪，很好地固定在底床。

detail_list.name: Mayaca fluviatilis
detail_list.introduction: Mayaca fluviatilis is a stem plant from South and Central America. The stem is extremely soft and flexible which, in addition to the very narrow, bright green leaves, gives the plant a light and graceful expression. It branches willingly and the rapid growth makes regular pruning necessary. This plant prefers soft, slightly acidic water, but it also thrives well in medium hard water. Mayaca fluviatilis is known to get very pale shoots if it lacks iron. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing. (Please notice that bunches/bundled plants are currently NOT produced at Tropica's own nursery. We are unable to guarantee that they are free from harmful pesticides and thus we recommend NOT to put them directly in tanks with shrimps and other delicate fish. Keep bundled plants in tanks where water is changed twice a week for 2 weeks before you add shrimps or fish)
detail_list.introduction_cn: 绿苔草是一种来自南美洲和中美洲的有茎草。茎极其柔软而富有弹性，加上非常狭窄、亮绿色的叶子，赋予植物轻盈优雅的表情。它愿意分枝，并且生长迅速，因此需要定期修剪。这种植物喜欢软、微酸性的水，但在中等硬水中也能生长良好。众所周知，如果绿苔草缺乏铁，它的芽会变得非常苍白。成束茎草或幼苗由配重环固定。取下配重环，将植株逐一分开。对于有茎草，除去最低 5 厘米 (2 英寸) 处的叶子。除去任何受损的叶子。将单株植物种植到底床中，并保持一定距离。植株很快会长出新根并恢复生长。（请注意，目前 Tropica 自己的苗圃不生产束状/捆绑植物。我们无法保证它们不含有害农药，因此我们建议不要将它们直接放入有虾和其他精致鱼类的水族箱中。将捆绑植物放在每周换水两次的水族箱中添加虾或鱼之前两周）

detail_list.name: Micranthemum callitrichoides ´Cuba´
detail_list.introduction: Micranthemum callitrichoides ’Cuba’ is one of the smallest aquarium plants in the world, and creeps over the bottom with millimetre-sized, round leaves. Micranthemum callitrichoides is an attractive and popular foreground plant for small aquariums. It is not a difficult plant, but it requires good conditions such as enough light, added CO2, water circulation and fertilizer to thrive. If these conditions are hard to create, you may use Micranthemum ‘Monte-Carlo’ as an alternative, as it is less demanding. Small pearls or bubbles of oxygen are often produced on top of the plants, adding a very lively aspect to the carpet.If planted in small clumps a few centimetres apart, it will spread rapidly and cover the bottom like a carpet. Trim the carpet regularly, otherwise the lower parts will not get enough light causing root death. Found on Cuba, west of Havana.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你矮珍珠是世界上最小的水草之一，以毫米大小的圆形叶子爬行在底部。Micranthemum callitrichoides 是一种有吸引力且受欢迎的小型水族箱前景草。它不是一种很难生长的植物，但它需要良好的条件，如充足的光照、补充 CO₂、水循环和肥料才能生长良好。如果这些条件很难创造，您可以使用 Micranthemum ‘Monte-Carlo’ 作为替代方案，因为它要求较低。植物顶部经常会产生小珍珠或氧气气泡，为草坪增添了非常活泼的一面。如果以几厘米间隔的小丛种植，它会迅速蔓延并像草坪一样覆盖底部。定期修剪草坪，否则下部得不到足够的光照，导致根系死亡。发现于古巴哈瓦那以西。

detail_list.name: Micranthemum glomeratum
detail_list.introduction: Hemianthus micranthemoides from North America is a graceful plant whose small, arched leaves make it look like a miniature version of Egeria. It has a characteristic trailing growth in intensive light, so it can be used as a foreground plant . A compact group of Hemianthus micranthemoides is very beautiful with its small, light-green leaves. In terrariums the plant forms a compact cushion. Used to be called Micranthemum micranthemoides.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自北美的小花菊 (Hemianthus miranthemoides) 是一种优雅的植物，其小而拱形的叶子使其看起来像 Egeria 的缩小版。它在强光下具有拖尾生长的特性，因此可以用作前景草。一群紧凑的小菊花，叶子小而浅绿色，非常美丽。在玻璃容器中，植物形成一个紧凑的垫子。过去被称为 Micranthemum microranthemoides。

detail_list.name: Micranthemum glomeratum

A compact group of Micranthemum glomeratum is very beautiful with its small, light-green leaves. In terrariums the plant forms a compact cushion. Used to be called Hemianthus micranthemoide.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自北美的日本珍珠草是一种优雅的植物，其小而拱形的叶子使它看起来像 Egeria 的缩小版。它在强光下具有拖尾生长的特征，因此可以用作前景草（茎高10-20 厘米，宽2-3 厘米）。紧凑的日本珍珠草群非常美丽，叶子小而浅绿色。在玻璃容器中，植物形成一个紧凑的垫子。过去被称为小菊花。

detail_list.name: Micranthemum tweediei 'Monte Carlo'
detail_list.introduction: Micranthemum tweediei 'Monte Carlo' originates from Argentina. It has compact, round and fresh light green leaves on creeping stalks and creates a fast-growing carpet in the front of the aquarium. The plant can grow in light shadow, but requires good light conditions, as well as CO2 additive, in order to develop optimally and become really compact.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 趴地珍珠源自阿根廷。它在匍匐茎上有紧凑、圆形和新鲜的浅绿色叶子，在水族箱前面形成了快速生长的草坪。该植物可以在光影下生长，但需要良好的光照条件以及 CO₂添加剂，以便最佳地生长并变得非常紧凑。

detail_list.introduction: Micranthemum umbrosum on grid 9 x 11 cm. Micranthemum umbrosum is a beautiful plant from US with small round leaves. It is suitable for small or large aquariums with stems becoming 10-25 cm long and 1-2 cm wide. Relatively demanding in terms of light. CO2 addition is recommended to promote growth. Once the plant starts growing it grows fast, and the shoots have to be pinched out often (can be planted as cuttings in the bottom). Most beautiful in groups of many stems.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 大珍珠草在 9 x 11 厘米网格上。大珍珠草是一种来自美国的美丽植物，叶子小而圆。它适用于茎长10-25 厘米、宽1-2 厘米的小型或大型水族箱。对光线要求比较高。建议添加 CO₂以促进生长。一旦植物开始生长，它就会生长得很快，并且必须经常掐掉芽（可以作为插条种入底床）。在许多茎组中最美丽。

detail_list.name: Microsorum - Anubias 'Duet'
detail_list.introduction: Microsorum pteropus and Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia rooted on a large piece of mangrove wood. Microsorum pteropus is a water fern from Asia, 15-30 cm tall, which should be grown on a root or stone, attached with fishing line until it has gained a hold. If it is planted in the bottom, do not cover the rhizome because it will rot. Easy to propagate by splitting the horizontal rhizome. A hardy plant which grows in all conditions. The black spots under the leaves are sporangia (reproductive organs), not signs of disease as many believe. Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia originates from an Australian tissue propagation laboratory. It is a very beautiful variety with heart-shaped leaves. The leaves live for several years, so Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia can easily form large groups despite its slow growth. A group of Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia growing more than 50 cm wide in a few years is not unusual.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 铁皇冠和卡拉迪榕扎根于一大块红树林上。铁皇冠是一种来自亚洲的水蕨类植物，高 15-30 厘米，应生长在根部或石材上，用钓鱼线固定直至其固定。如果种在底部，不要覆盖根茎，因为它会腐烂。水平根茎分裂，易于繁殖。一种在任何条件下都能生长的耐寒植物。叶子下的黑点是孢子囊（生殖器官），而不是许多人认为的疾病迹象。卡拉迪榕源自澳大利亚组织繁殖实验室。这是一个观赏性较强的品种，叶子呈心形。叶子的寿命长达数年，因此卡拉迪榕尽管生长缓慢，但很容易形成大群。一群卡拉迪榕在几年内长到50多厘米宽并不罕见。

detail_list.name: Microsorum pteropus 'Windeløv'
detail_list.introduction: Microsorum pteropus 'Windeløv' is a patented variety of Microsorum pteropus, named after Tropica's founder Holger Windeløv. Its finely branched leaf tips make it one of the most beautiful aquarium plants. The Microsorum variety becomes 15-20 cm tall and wide. A hardy and easy plant for both beginners and the more experienced. Best results are obtained by planting it on a stone or tree root. If planted in the bottom the horizontal rhizome must not be covered. This plant is not eaten by herbivorous fish.

detail_list.name: Monosolenium tenerum
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. The Asian Monosolenium tenerum is an attractive liverwort, 2-5 cm high, which looks most like a giant Riccia that simply stays at the bottom, where it forms cushions. It is a brittle plant, and pieces break off easily, so it is best to place it in the aquarium attached to stones with fishing line or in small clumps among other plants such as Eleocharis. Once Monosolenium has established itself, it is very undemanding. This plant is mistakenly known as Pellia.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。亚洲珊瑚莫丝是一种观赏性较好的地钱，高 2-5 厘米，看起来最像一个巨大的 Riccia，它只是停留在底部，形成垫子。它是一种脆性植物，碎片很容易折断，因此最好将其放置在用鱼线固定在石材上的水族箱中，或者与其他植物（例如 Eleocharis）成小丛。Monosolenium 一旦建立起来，要求就非常低。这种植物被误称为 Pellia。

detail_list.name: Murdannia keisak
detail_list.introduction: This bamboo-looking stem plant is not a grass. It comes from Asia, where it often grows in rice fields. The growth is upright, but the plant branches out willingly when it is cut back. The leaf is light green, approx. 1cm wide and 3-5cm long. The stem apex becomes reddish when exposed to CO2 and strong light. Due to quick growth, the longest shoots require ongoing cut back and some of the tops can be replanted, in order to maintain a beautiful and varied group of plants.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 这种看起来像竹子的有茎草不是草。它来自亚洲，通常生长在稻田中。生长是直立的，但当修剪时，植物会容易分枝。叶子是浅绿色的，大约。宽1 厘米，长3-5 厘米。当暴露于 CO₂和强光下时，茎尖会变红。由于生长速度快，最长的芽需要不断修剪，并且可以重新种植一些顶部，以保持美丽且多样化的植物群。

detail_list.name: Myriophyllum mattogrossense
detail_list.introduction: Myriophyllum matogrossense originates from Mato Grosso in the Rio Amazonas, Brazil. It has decorative and feather-like, reddish stems (30-60 cm long) and finely divided bright green leaves (5 cm wide). In good light conditions the leaves spread out in a fan shape. Myriophyllum is relatively easy and is suitable for the background. It needs frequent trims to maintain its bushy form. It is fast growing and requires a good deal of nutrition. A good starter plant.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Myriophyllum matogrossense 源自巴西亚马逊河的马托格罗索州。它具有装饰性的羽毛状红色茎（30-60 厘米长）和细碎的亮绿色叶子（5 厘米宽）。在光照充足的情况下，叶子呈扇形展开。Myriophyllum 比较简单，适合做背景。它需要经常修剪以保持其浓密的形状。它的生长速度很快，需要大量的营养。一个很好的起始植物。

Every stem will only measure approximately 2-3 cm (1”), but it branches willingly and the plant quickly becomes dense and lush. Cutting down is often necessary to maintain the access to light and water flow. Its moderate growth makes Myriophyllum ‘Guyana’ particularly adapted to nano tanks.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。即使在非常高的光照强度下，Myriophyllum 也能保持明亮的绿色。每根茎的尺寸仅为约 2-3 厘米 (1”)，但它会容易分枝，植物很快就会变得茂密而茂盛。为了保持光照和水流，通常需要修剪。它的适度生长使 Myriophyllum ‘Guyana’ 适合迷你水族箱。

detail_list.name: Najas guadalupensis 'Guppy Grass'
detail_list.introduction: Originating from the USA and South America, Najas guadalupensis is an exceptionally easy aquatic plant that thrives under almost any conditions. It grows quickly and propagates effortlessly, making it ideal for beginners as well as experienced aquarists. Although usually kept as a free-floating plant, it may anchor itself in the substrate with long, delicate roots. The fine, porous structure provides excellent shelter for fish fry and shrimp, while also helping to absorb excess nutrients and produce oxygen. Perfect for both aquariums and ponds, Najas guadalupensis supports a healthy, balanced environment and offers a natural hiding place for aquatic life.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Najas guadalupensis 原产于美国和南美洲，是一种非常容易生长的水草，几乎在任何条件下都能繁衍生息。它生长迅速，繁殖毫不费力，适合初学者和经验丰富的水草玩家。虽然通常作为自由漂浮的植物保存，但它可以通过长而脆弱的根将自身固定在底床中。精细的多孔结构为鱼苗和虾提供了良好的庇护所，同时也有助于吸收多余的养分并产生氧气。Najas guadalupensis 适合水族箱和池塘，支持健康、平衡的环境，并为水生生物提供天然的藏身之处。

detail_list.name: Nymphaea lotus
detail_list.introduction: A beautiful and very varied species from West Africa with leaves of green to red-brown and varying numbers of purple spots. Can grow from 20-80 cm tall. Before forming floating leaves Nymphaea lotus (zenkeri) forms many underwater leaves. If you don't want floating leaves, prune the roots and leaves. The beautiful, aromatic flowers can be fully appreciated in open aquariums. A nutritious bottom encourages growth. Often available in a red and a green variety. Recommended as a solitary plant for large aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自西非的一种美丽且种类繁多的物种，叶子呈绿色到红棕色，并有不同数量的紫色斑点。可以长到20-80 厘米高。在形成浮叶之前，虎斑睡莲（zenkeri）会形成许多水下叶子。如果不想浮叶，就修剪根部和叶子。在开放的水族箱中可以充分欣赏到美丽而芳香的花朵。富含养分的底床促进生长。通常有红色和绿色品种。推荐作为大型水族箱的单生植物。

detail_list.name: Nymphoides hydrophylla 'Taiwan'
detail_list.introduction: Nymphoides sp. grows in Asia and Africa - and this variant of the species originates from southern Taiwan. The rosette plant can become 15-25 cm tall and 10-15 cm wide. This variant is characterized by many underwater leaves and the intense, light-green, transparent colour of the plant. The plant is fast-growing and it is necessary to thin out the leaves (remove oldest leaves and surface leaves). The plant is easy to care for under varying conditions, but for optimal growth it requires a lot of nourishment. The new plant grows from the plates of old leaves.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Nymphoides sp。生长于亚洲和非洲，该物种的这种变种起源于台湾南部。莲座丛植物可以长到15-25 厘米高，10-15 厘米宽。该变种的特点是有许多水下叶子以及植物浓烈的浅绿色透明颜色。该植物生长速度快，需要疏叶（除去最老的叶子和表面叶子）。这种植物在不同的条件下都很容易照顾，但为了实现最佳生长，它需要大量的营养。新植物是从老叶的盘中长出来的。

detail_list.name: Phyllanthus fluitans
detail_list.introduction: Originated from the American tropics, Phyllanthus fluitans is a floating plant part of the Phyllanthaceae family. It is similar to the Salvinia, differentiated only by the mono leave structure on each node. The water repellent, heart shaped leaves hide the stem which can sometimes give life to white flowers with six petals. The more intense the light, the browner the leaves will become. Sustainably cultivated in Denmark.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红毛丹浮萍起源于美洲热带地区，是叶下珠科的漂浮植物。它与 Salvinia 类似，区别仅在于每个节点上的单叶结构。防水的心形叶子隐藏了茎，有时可以赋予六瓣白色花朵生命。光线越强，叶子就会变得越棕色。在丹麦可持续种植。

detail_list.name: Plagiomnium sp. 'Thyme Moss'
detail_list.introduction: Plagiomnium sp. 'Thyme Moss' is an attractive moss with a distinctive appearance that sets it apart from many other mosses used in terrariums. Resembling the North American species Plagiomnium cuspidatum, it develops comparatively large leaves that create a lush and textured look. The bright green leaves are translucent and feature elegant wavy margins, giving the moss a fresh, vibrant appearance under humid terrarium conditions. Its larger leaf size adds visual interest and contrast when combined with finer mosses or tropical plants. Easy to incorporate into natural layouts, Plagiomnium sp. 'Thyme Moss' is ideal for creating soft green carpets, covering decorative elements, or bringing a woodland-like atmosphere to terrariums and paludariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 百里香莫丝是一种观赏性较好的莫丝，具有独特的外观，使其与玻璃容器中使用的许多其他莫丝区分开来。与北美物种 Plagiomnium cuspidatum 类似，它长出相对较大的叶子，营造出郁郁葱葱且有质感的外观。明亮的绿色叶子是半透明的，具有优雅的波浪形边缘，使莫丝在潮湿的玻璃容器条件下呈现出新鲜、鲜艳的外观。当与更细的莫丝或热带植物结合时，其较大的叶子尺寸增加了视觉兴趣和对比度。百里香莫丝易于融入自然布局，适合打造柔软的绿色草坪、覆盖装饰元素或为玻璃容器和沼泽池带来林地般的氛围。

detail_list.name: Pogostemon deccanensis
detail_list.introduction: The Indian Pogostemon deccanensis (formerly known as Pogostemon erectus) forms compact groups of bright green, conifer-like stems, 15-40 cm tall and 1-3 cm wide. Pogostemon erectus is suitable as a background plant and creates a wonderful focal point in both smaller and larger groups. Intense light helps the plant to stay compact for a longer period. Moderate growth and vigorous roots. Plants will need frequent pruning, and cut off shoots will easily start growing when planted.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 印度德干刺蕊草（以前称为 Pogostemon 直立树）形成紧凑的亮绿色针叶树状茎群，高 15-40 厘米，宽 1-3 厘米。Pogostemon 直立植物适合作为后景草，在较小和较大的群体中都能创造出美妙的焦点。强光有助于植物更长时间地保持紧凑。生长适中，根系旺盛。植物需要经常修剪，剪掉的枝条在种植后很容易开始生长。

detail_list.name: Pogostemon helferi
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. This plant was discovered by aquarists in Thailand, close to the border with Burma. It is called 'Downoi' (little star) in Thailand, and it is easy to see why (5-10 cm tall and wide). Pogostemon helferi is an unusual and distinctive aquatic plant with a compact habit, curly leaves and a strikingly beautiful green colour. With good light conditions and a substrate rich in nutrients Pogostemon helferi forms many side shoots, which develop small roots, and the plant rapidly forms an impressive carpet of foreground vegetation.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。这种植物是由泰国的水草玩家在靠近缅甸边境的地方发现的。它在泰国被称为“Downoi”（小星星），原因很容易理解（高和宽 5-10 厘米）。喷泉太阳是一种不寻常且独特的水草，具有紧凑的习性、卷曲的叶子和惊人绿色。在良好的光照条件和富含养分的底床下，喷泉太阳会形成许多侧枝，这些侧枝会发育成小根，植物迅速形成令人印象深刻的前景植被草坪。

detail_list.name: Pogostemon helferi
detail_list.introduction: Pogostemon helferi on lava stone. Aquarists in Thailand, close to the border with Burma, discovered this plant. It is called 'Downoi' (little star) in Thailand, and it is easy to see why (5-10 cm tall and wide). detail_list.introduction_cn: 喷泉太阳位于熔石材上。靠近缅甸边境的泰国的水草玩家发现了这种植物。它在泰国被称为“Downoi”（小星星），原因很容易理解（高和宽 5-10 厘米）。喷泉太阳是一种不寻常且独特的水草，具有紧凑的习性、卷曲的叶子和惊人绿色。在良好的光照条件和营养丰富的底床下，喷泉太阳会形成许多侧枝，并发育出小根，并且植物迅速形成令人印象深刻的前景植被草坪。

detail_list.name: Pogostemon quadrifolius
detail_list.introduction: Pogostemon quadrifolius from Laos is a distinctive stem plant closely related to Pogostemon stellatus. It is often referred to as Pogostemon stellatus ‘Octopus’ due to its characteristic growth form. This plant is very easy to care for and grows strongly under a wide range of conditions, making it a reliable choice for both new and experienced aquarists. Regular trimming is recommended to maintain a compact and tidy appearance, as the plant quickly produces new shoots. Replanting head cuttings encourages dense growth, while side shoots can also be used and develop at a slightly slower pace, which makes them well suited for smaller aquariums and Nano Cubes.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自老挝的四叶刺蕊草是一种与百叶草密切相关的独特有茎草。由于其独特的生长形式，它通常被称为百叶草“章鱼”。这种植物非常容易照料，并且在各种条件下都能生长旺盛，使其成为新手和经验丰富的鱼友的可靠选择。建议定期修剪，以保持紧凑整洁的外观，因为植物会很快产生新芽。重新种植头部插条可以促进密集的生长，同时也可以使用侧枝并以稍慢的速度生长，这使得它们适合较小的水族箱和纳米立方体。

detail_list.name: Pogostemon stellatus
detail_list.introduction: Pogostemon stellata from Asia and Australia is distinguished by its beautiful shape and colour. Stems from 20-60 cm and up to 10 cm wide. It is difficult to grow in aquariums. It requires intensive light and the addition of CO2 to grow well. The shortage of micronutrients leads to pale leaves, which may be an indication that the aquarium needs fertiliser. Even in good conditions growth sometimes stops suddenly. Plants in aquarium shops are generally low, compact plants grown in marshy conditions, and do not reveal their full glory until planted in the aquarium.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自亚洲和澳大利亚的 Pogostemon 星状花以其形状和颜色而著称。茎长20-60 厘米，宽达10 厘米。在水族箱中很难生长。它需要强光和添加 CO₂才能生长良好。微量养分的缺乏会导致叶子苍白，这可能表明水族箱需要肥料。即使在良好的条件下，生长有时也会突然停止。水族箱店里的植物一般都是生长在沼泽条件下的低矮、紧凑的植物，只有种植在水族箱中才能展现出它们的全部光彩。

detail_list.name: Proserpinaca palustris 'Cuba'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Proserpinaca is a stem plant, 10-40 cm tall and 5-10 cm wide. Cultivated in closed cups and delivered with saw-toothed leaves, which after a transitional period in the aquarium develop into long, finely denticulated, needle-like leaves. In good light conditions it turns a beautiful copper colour and its characteristic appearance is a pleasing contrast to the other plants. Proserpinaca palustris varies in form according to its origin. The Tropica cultivar is found on the Isla de la Juventud off Cuba. In the USA the plant is commonly known as "mermaid weed''.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。Proserpinaca 是有茎草，高10-40 厘米，宽5-10 厘米。在封闭的杯子中培养，并产生锯齿状叶子，在水族箱中经过一段过渡期后，会发育成长而细齿状的针状叶子。在光照条件良好的情况下，它会变成铜色，其独特的外观与其他植物形成令人愉悦的对比。Proserpinaca 沼泽藻的形态根据其来源而有所不同。Tropica 品种发现于古巴附近的青年岛上。在美国，这种植物通常被称为“美人鱼草”。

detail_list.name: Ranunculus inundatus
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. This species comes from Australia and becomes 5-10 cm tall. There are many species and variants of Ranunculus, which grow coarse and leggy in aquariums. Ranunculus inundatus is characterised by its compact form and distinguished, deeply cut umbrellas. The plant forms many vertical runners with new plants and over time thick bottom coverage is formed. Good lighting produces compact growth. Long leaves can be pruned.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。该物种来自澳大利亚，高5-10 厘米。Ranunculus 有许多种和变种，它们在水族箱中生长得粗壮且徒长。鹿角矮珍珠的特点是其紧凑的外形和独特的深切伞。植物与新植物形成许多垂直的通道，随着时间的推移，形成厚厚的底部覆盖。良好的光照可以促进紧凑的生长。长叶子可以修剪。

detail_list.name: Riccardia chamedryfolia
detail_list.introduction: Riccardia Chamedryfolia, now available in Tropica’s 1-2-Grow! range, is a distinctive liverwort moss that brings intricate texture to aquascapes. Known for its delicate, coral-like appearance, this plant is ideal for adding subtle detail to hardscapes, whether attached to rocks, driftwood, or used as a carpet. Its rich green color enhances the natural feel of any setup, making it popular among aquascapers looking for a refined, organic look. This moss is well-suited to low to moderate lighting and can adapt to a variety of water conditions. Slow-growing and easy to maintain, Riccardia Chamedryfolia forms dense, compact clusters, allowing aquarists to create defined, textured patches with minimal trimming. Its unique look makes it a versatile addition to any aquascape, perfect for achieving a mature, established feel. Key Benefits Distinctive Texture: Adds intricate detail to hardscapes. Versatile Attachment: Great for rocks and driftwood. Slow Growth: Minimal maintenance required. Compact Clusters: Creates dense, textured patches. Adaptable Conditions: Thrives in varied setups. Riccardia Chamedryfolia in the 1-2-Grow! range is an ideal choice for aquarists who appreciate refined details and want to add a unique, natural element to their aquascape.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 珊瑚莫丝属于叶苔类，枝体细密，外形近似珊瑚，适合固定在石材或沉木上，也可铺成低矮草坪。它适应低到中等光照和多种水质，生长缓慢，修剪需求较少，能够形成紧密的小丛。

detail_list.name: Riccia fluitans
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Japanese Takashi Amano has inspired many aquarium owners to keep the 1-5 cm tall cosmopolitic liverwort, Riccia fluitans, submerged. It can be kept down by tying it to a stone with a piece of fishing line, but new shoots always grow towards the surface, so it may be necessary to prune it with scissors. Riccia fluitans thrives best with added CO2 and in good growing conditions small oxygen bubbles form on the leaf tips. As a traditional floating plant it offers good protection for young fish.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。日本天野隆 (Takashi Amano) 启发许多水族箱主人将 1-5 厘米高的世界性地钱鹿角苔保持在水中。可以用一根钓鱼线把它绑在石材上来抑制它，但新芽总是向表面生长，所以可能需要用剪刀修剪它。鹿角苔在添加 CO₂的情况下生长得最好，在良好的生长条件下，叶尖上会形成小氧气泡。作为传统的漂浮植物，它为幼鱼提供了良好的保护。

detail_list.name: Rotala indica 'Bonsai'
detail_list.introduction: Rotala indica 'Bonsai' is best described as a compact, moderate growing version of Bacopa caroliniana. Plant it in small groups and trim it often. Cuttings may be re-planted in the group to achieve a more dense group or carpet. At high light the tip of the stems may become reddish, at lower light the leaves will become larger and the plant less compact. Rotala 'Bonsai' is particularly suitable for nano-aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 印度小圆叶最好的描述是虎耳草的紧凑型、中等生长版本。将其分成小群种植并经常修剪。可以将插条重新种植在组中，以获得更密集的组或草坪。在强光下，茎尖可能会变红，在弱光下，叶子会变大，植物不那么紧凑。Rotala“盆景”适合迷你水族箱。

detail_list.name: Rotala macrandra
detail_list.introduction: Rotala macrandra ‘Japan’ is a magnificent aquarium plant, but unfortunately, it is very demanding. This variant is a little easier to grow and develops better coloration. It needs very good light to develop its beautiful red shades, just like CO2 addition and soft water are vital to ensure optimal growth. Cut the longest stems 5-10 cm from the ground and replant them in the group.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 红蝴蝶‘日本’是一个宏伟的水草，但不幸的是，它的要求非常高。这个变种更容易生长，并且颜色更好。它需要非常好的光照才能形成红色色调，就像添加 CO₂和软水对于确保最佳生长至关重要一样。将最长的茎剪离地面 5-10 厘米，然后重新种植在组中。

detail_list.name: Rotala rotundifolia
detail_list.introduction: The Latin name means "the plant with the round leaves'', but this only applies to the marsh variety, which has circular leaves. Rotala rotundifolia from South-East Asia has 15-30 long stems (2-3 cm wide) and long, narrow leaves. Unlike other Rotala species it is relatively undemanding, although it needs good light to produce red leaves. It forms side shoots willingly, becoming compact and bushy. This also means that it is hard for light to reach the lower leaves, so the plant should be pruned frequently. Also known as Rotala indica.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 拉丁名的意思是“圆叶植物”，但这仅适用于具有圆形叶子的沼泽品种。来自东南亚的红宫廷具有15-30个长茎（2-3 厘米宽）和狭长的叶子。与其他 Rotala 品种不同，它相对要求不高，尽管它需要良好的光照才能产生红叶。它愿意形成侧枝，变得紧凑而浓密。这也意味着它很难种植光到达下部叶子，因此应经常修剪该植物也称为 Rotala 籼稻。

detail_list.name: Rotala rotundifolia

detail_list.name: Rotala rotundifolia 'Blood Red'
detail_list.introduction: 'Blood Red' is the most intensely red-colored variation of Rotala rotundifolia. Placing it next to light green plants will enhance its vibrant red color. This plant is easy to grow and can thrive in relatively low light and nutrient conditions. However, to achieve the most intense coloration, plenty of light and added CO2 are necessary. The plant grows erect to slightly arching, producing many branches. Regular trimming is needed to ensure good light penetration and water flow among the stems.
detail_list.introduction_cn: “血红”是红宫廷中红色最强烈的变体。将其放置在浅绿色植物旁边会增强其鲜艳的红色。这种植物很容易生长，可以在相对较低的光照和营养条件下生长良好。然而，为了获得最强烈的着色，充足的光线和添加的 CO₂是必要的。植物直立生长，略呈拱形，产生许多分枝。需要定期修剪，以确保茎之间良好的透光性和水流。

detail_list.name: Rotala rotundifolia 'Green'
detail_list.introduction: The Asiatic Rotala sp. ‘Green’ is very similar to Rotala rotundifolia, but its leaves remain fresh and bright green, even with intensive light. Stems becomes 40-50 cm long and 2-3 cm wide. The plant forms many side shoots willingly and obtains a beautiful, bushy and "hanging" growth. Prune it frequently to maintain healthy growth. An ideal starter plant that looks best when planted in large groups.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 亚洲 Rotala sp。“Green”与红宫廷非常相似，但它的叶子即使在强光下也能保持新鲜和亮绿色。茎长40-50 厘米，宽2-3 厘米。该植物容易形成许多侧枝，并获得美丽、浓密和“悬挂”的生长。经常修剪以保持健康生长。一种理想的起始植物，大群种植时看起来效果最好。

detail_list.name: Rotala rotundifolia 'H'ra'
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Rotala 'H’ra' has rather narrow leaves and an overhanging or creeping growth. It is probably a variation of Rotala rotundifolia and has much resemblance to Rotala sp. ‘Green’. High light levels, good fertilization and added CO2 will induce almost exclusively creeping growth and a warm, rich orange coloration. This makes it possible to create a dense, orange mid-ground cushion or even an unusual, orange foreground carpet.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。Rotala 'H'ra' 的叶子相当狭窄，并且有悬垂或匍匐生长。它可能是红宫廷的变体，与 Rotala sp 非常相似。'绿色的'。高光照水平、良好的施肥和添加的 CO₂将几乎完全诱导匍匐生长和温暖、丰富的橙色。这使得可以创建一个致密的橙色中景垫子，甚至一个不寻常的橙色前景草坪。

detail_list.name: Rotala wallichii
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Rotala wallichii is a demanding plant that develops red shoot tips in good light conditions. The most decorative effect can be achieved by planting a large number of stems in a group. Rotala walichii is good as background and midground plant and suitable even for small aquariums, because it is easy to prune if it grows too tall. CO2 addition boosts growth considerably. It also prefers soft, slightly acidic water.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。红松尾是一种要求较高的植物，在良好的光照条件下会形成红色的芽尖。大量种植成群的茎可以达到最具装饰性的效果。Rotala walichii 适合作为背景和中地植物，甚至适合小型水族箱，因为如果它长得太高，很容易修剪。CO₂的添加大大促进了增长。它还喜欢软的、微酸性的水。

detail_list.name: Sagittaria subulata
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Sagittaria subulata from South America is an ideal, undemanding foreground plant whose short runners form a compact group. Place individual plants 2-4 cm apart. This plant may cause problems because in certain conditions it suddenly grows to a height of 50 cm when it grows older. But if it is then moved into the background it may become low again. In the aquarium it sometimes sends a long flower stem to the surface, and small white flowers unfold just above the water surface.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。来自南美的迷你水兰是一种理想的、要求不高的前景草，其短跑者形成一个紧凑的群体。将单株植物间隔 2-4 厘米放置。这种植物可能会引起问题，因为在某些条件下，当它长大时，它会突然长到 50 厘米高。但如果随后将其移至后台，则可能会再次变低。在水族箱中，它有时会发出长长的花茎到水面，白色的小花就在水面上方展开。

In the aquarium, it sometimes sends a long flower stem to the surface, and small white flowers unfold just above the water surface.

detail_list.name: Sagittaria subulata 'Needle Leaf'
detail_list.introduction: Sagittaria sp. 'Needle' is a stunning, narrow-leaved aquatic plant, likely a variation of Sagittaria subulata. With slender leaves reaching 15–30 cm in length and only a few millimeters wide, this plant adds a delicate, elegant touch to any freshwater aquarium. Ideal for aquascaping, Sagittaria 'Needle' is easy to grow, thriving in moderate light without the need for additional CO2. Under intense lighting, its vibrant green foliage may develop subtle orange hues, enhancing its visual appeal. This hardy plant spreads effortlessly via runners, making propagation simple—just trim and replant as needed. Thanks to its compact, upright growth, Sagittaria 'Needle' is a fantastic choice for creating a soft, natural-looking background in aquariums. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced aquascaper, this low-maintenance plant is a great addition to any aquatic setup.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 针叶水兰可能是迷你水兰的一个变种，叶片狭长，长约 15-30 厘米，宽仅数毫米。它容易养护，中等光照下即可生长，无需额外补充 CO₂；强光下叶片可能略带橙色。植株直立，适合作为自然风格的后景草，并可通过走茎繁殖。

detail_list.name: Salvinia minima
detail_list.introduction: Salvinia minima is a cosmopolitan floating fern, 1-3 cm that grows quickly if there is sufficient nutrition and light. Light leaves are a sign of a shortage of micronutrients. It tends to shade light from the plants at the bottom. Salvinia varieties have small hairs on their leaves, making them water resistant. Helps prevent algae by shading parts of the aquarium and using nutrients in the water. Grows very big in the wild and in optimum conditions. A decorative plant for open aquariums.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 小槐叶萍是一种世界性的漂浮蕨类植物，1-3 厘米，如果有足够的营养和光照，生长很快。叶子颜色浅是微量养分缺乏的标志。它往往会遮挡底部植物的光线。Salvinia 品种的叶子上有小毛，使其具有防水性。通过遮蔽水族箱的某些部分并利用水中的养分来帮助防止藻类。在野外和最佳条件下生长得很大。开放式水族箱的装饰植物。

detail_list.name: Schismatoglottis prietoi
detail_list.introduction: Schismatoglottis prietoi can resemble Anubias, wit 3-8 cm long, eliptic leaves. Growth is faster, though, and it grows best planted in the bottom layer, where it willingly produces runners. It is an undemanding and easy plant, thriving very well in most aquaria, even in very poor light. Schismatoglottis prietoi naturally grows in rivers of the Phillipines, where it often appears in large, dense groups.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 普列托水榕芋与水榕相似，叶子长 3-8 厘米，呈椭圆形。不过，它的生长速度更快，而且种植在底床生长得最好，在那里它容易长出匍匐茎。它是一种要求不高且容易生长的植物，即使在光线很差的情况下，在大多数水族箱中也能生长得很好。普列托水榕芋天然生长在菲律宾的河流中，经常以大而密集的群体出现。

detail_list.name: Selaginella uncinata
detail_list.introduction: Selaginella uncinata is a distinctive trailing moss fern prized for its shimmering blue-green foliage. The delicate leaves cover the stems densely, creating a lush carpet of colour that stands out beautifully among traditional green terrarium plants. Its creeping growth habit makes it ideal for covering the substrate, softening hardscape elements, or adding depth to tropical terrarium layouts. Once established, it grows vigorously and may spread over neighbouring plants, but it responds well to regular trimming and shaping. Easy to cultivate and highly decorative, Selaginella uncinata is an excellent choice for hobbyists looking to introduce unique colour and texture into humid tropical environments.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 翠云草是一种匍匐生长的卷柏类植物，茎叶密集，叶片带有蓝绿色光泽，适合潮湿的雨林缸或沼泽缸。它可以覆盖底床和造景素材，成活后生长较快，也可能蔓延到邻近植物上，可通过定期修剪控制范围。

detail_list.name: Shinnersia rivularis 'Weiss-Grün'
detail_list.introduction: Variety of Shinnersia rivularis, distinguished by the white veins on the leaves, 30-60 cm long and up to 10 cm wide stems. This colour mutation was discovered at the Dennerle aquarium plant nursery. The plant grows rapidly and soon reaches the water surface, but shoots can simply be pinched off and planted back in the bottom. Shinnersia does not appreciate high temperatures. It tends to become leggy, but several plants placed in a group, will improve the appearance. The colours will develop optimally at good light conditions.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Shinnersia rivularis 品种，以叶子上的白色纹理为特征，长 30-60 厘米，茎宽达 10 厘米。这种颜色突变是在 Dennerle 水草苗圃中发现的。植物生长迅速，很快就会到达水面，但可以简单地将芽剪掉并重新种入底床。Shinnersia 不喜欢高温。它往往会变得徒长，但将几株植物放在一组，会改善外观。在良好的光照条件下，颜色会呈现最佳效果。

detail_list.name: Solenostoma tetragonum 'Pearl Moss'
detail_list.introduction: Solenostoma tetragonum 'Pearl Moss' is a rare and distinctive liverwort from Borneo, offering a fresh and highly decorative look compared to traditional aquarium mosses. Its small, round, translucent leaves form dense, cushion-like growth with a deep green colour that adds detail and texture to any aquascape. This species grows slowly and attaches naturally to rocks and driftwood, where it develops compact, elegant mats. It is ideal for nano aquariums or for adding fine structure in larger layouts, especially in combination with Bucephalandra and other shade-loving species. Solenostoma tetragonum thrives under stable conditions with CO2 injection and a good nutrient balance. With time and proper care, it rewards the aquarist with striking, pearl-like oxygen bubbles forming between its closely packed leaves.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 珍珠莫丝是产自婆罗洲的叶苔类植物。小而圆的半透明叶片会形成深绿色、垫状的紧密株丛。它生长缓慢，可自然附着在石材和沉木上，适合迷你水族箱或大型造景中的细节位置，也可与辣椒榕等耐阴水草搭配。稳定的环境、均衡施肥和补充 CO₂ 有利于生长；状态良好时，密集叶片间会出现珍珠状氧气泡。

detail_list.name: Spirodela polyrrhiza
detail_list.introduction: Spirodela polyrrhiza, commonly known as Greater Duckweed, is a versatile floating plant that adds a natural, dynamic element to aquariums. Its small, round, green fronds float freely on the water's surface, creating a serene, pond-like appearance. This plant is ideal for providing shade and shelter for fish, reducing light penetration, and helping to control algae growth. Thriving in low to moderate lighting, Spirodela polyrrhiza is easy to care for and grows rapidly, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced aquarists. Its fast growth rate aids in nutrient absorption, contributing to improved water quality. Regular thinning is recommended to prevent excessive coverage and ensure balanced light distribution to submerged plants. Key Benefits Natural Shade: Offers shelter and reduces light for fish. Algae Control: Competes for nutrients, limiting algae growth. Water Quality Improvement: Absorbs excess nutrients efficiently. Spirodela polyrrhiza is an excellent choice for aquarists seeking a low-maintenance, functional plant that enhances the natural aesthetics and health of their aquarium ecosystem.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 紫萍是漂浮在水面的浮水植物，小而圆的绿色叶状体可为鱼类遮阴并提供躲藏处。它在低到中等光照下都能快速生长，通过吸收水中养分抑制藻类并改善水质。需要定期捞除过密植株，避免遮挡下层水草的光照。

detail_list.name: Staurogyne repens
detail_list.introduction: Live aquatic plant in pot, packed in a breathable blister packaging to go. Staurogyne repens is a fresh green, compact and hardy plant for the foreground of the aquarium and it was found in River Rio Cristalino in the southern Amazonas. Its nearest relative in the aquaristic is Hygrophila but Staurogyne is different with its marked compact, low and bushy stature (5-10 cm) and small green leaves (each stem is 3.4 cm wide). During planting in the aquarium, the longest upright shoots should be cut off and new horizontally creeping shoots will soon form from the plant basis and gradually colonize the gravel.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 盆栽水草，采用透气吸塑包装。矮生叉柱花是一种新鲜绿色、紧凑且耐寒的植物，适合用作水族箱的前景，它发现于亚马逊南部的里奥克里斯塔利诺河。它在水族中的近亲是 Hygrophila，但 Staurogyne 的不同之处在于其明显紧凑、低矮且浓密的身材（5-10 厘米）和小绿叶（每茎宽3.4 厘米）。在水族箱中种植期间，应剪掉最长的直立芽，新的水平匍匐芽很快就会从植物基础上形成并逐渐在砾石上生长。

detail_list.introduction: Staurogyne repens is a fresh green, compact and hardy plant for the foreground of the aquarium and it was found in River Rio Cristalino in the southern Amazonas. Its nearest relative in the aquaristic is Hygrophila but Staurogyne is different with its marked compact, low and bushy stature (5-10 cm) and small green leaves (each stem is 3.4 cm wide). At low light, the growth will be more upright and much less side shoots will be formed.

detail_list.name: Taxiphyllum alternans 'Taiwan Moss'
detail_list.introduction: Growth of Mini Taiwan moss is horizontal and overhanging, like a mini version of 'Weeping moss'. Attaching to branching wood or vertical rock will present it at its best and is also very useful for a moss wall or for hiding installations in the aquarium. It is an easy and decorative moss with quite low demands, but good light and some added CO2 will promote growth and branching. Full identity of this beautiful moss is not yet established and studies may likely place it as a species of family Isopterygium.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 迷你台湾苔的生长是水平且悬垂的，就像迷你版的“垂苔”。附着在树枝或垂直石材上将使其处于最佳状态，并且对于莫丝墙或水族箱中的隐藏装置也非常有用。它是一种简单且具有装饰性的莫丝，要求相当低，但良好的光照和添加一些 CO₂将促进生长和分枝。这种莫丝的完整身份尚未确定，研究可能将其归为等翅藻科的一种。

detail_list.name: Taxiphyllum barbieri 'Bogor Moss'
detail_list.introduction: Taxiphyllum barbieri 'Bogor Moss' from South-East Asia is a hardy plant which makes few demands on the water or light. The moss becomes 3-10 cm thick and grows willingly on any surface, so it is ideal for decorating stones and tree roots or concealing installations in the aquarium. Attach the plant with a piece of fishing line or cotton thread until it has gained a hold on the décor. If its growth becomes too luxuriant, it can be pruned with scissors. In breeding aquariums Taxiphyllum barbieri is a wonderful hiding place for the young fish.

detail_list.name: Taxiphyllum sp. ’Flame Moss’
detail_list.introduction: Aquarium plant from tissue culture in closed cup. Asian Flame moss got its name from its form of growth. Tight, vertical and softly undulating shoots give the impression of a deep green campfire, 5-15 cm high. The special shape makes Flame moss very suitable for horizontal surfaces and it only spreads slowly horizontally. Attach the moss to small stones or in small bundles on tree roots to obtain a lovely effect.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 采用密封杯组织培养的水草。亚洲火焰莫丝因其生长形式而得名。紧密、垂直且柔和起伏的芽给人一种深绿色篝火的印象，高5-15 厘米。特殊的形状使火焰莫丝适合水平表面，并且仅在水平方向上缓慢蔓延。将莫丝附着在小石材上或小束地附着在沉木上，以获得可爱的效果。

detail_list.name: Taxiphyllum sp. 'Spiky Moss'
detail_list.introduction: ‘Spiky Moss’ is Asiatic and grows 2-10 cm tall. Best described as Christmas moss' big brother, it is bigger and forms many deep green, branched shoots.Spiky moss does best on vertical surfaces where the branched shoots will show. A beautiful carpeting effect is possible if you plant small tufts into the bottom substrate with a small interspace. It grows fast and thrives at a very low light intensity.
detail_list.introduction_cn: “Spiky Moss”是亚洲植物，高 2-10 厘米。最好将其描述为圣诞莫丝的老大哥，它更大，并形成许多深绿色的分枝芽。尖刺莫丝在垂直表面上表现最好，在那里分枝芽会显现出来。如果您将小簇绒种植到具有较小间隙的底部基材中，则可以形成草坪效果。它生长速度快，并且在非常低的光照强度下生长良好。

detail_list.name: Utricularia graminifolia
detail_list.introduction: Utricularia graminifolia from Asia belongs to the bladderwort family. All the plants in this family are insect eating, perennial water and marsh plants. In the nature, the plant lives in nutrient-poor places, hence the need to catch small insects and digest them. Bladder traps are a unique feature of this family, which Utricularia graminifolia forms after a short period in the aquarium. The species name means 'with grass like leaves' and the fresh green leaves will after some time form a pretty mat which looks like a lawn (2-8 cm tall). Utricularia graminifolia is therefore an ideal foreground plant, although it is rather demanding.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 挖耳草来自亚洲，属于狸藻科。该科的所有植物都是食虫、多年生水草和沼泽植物。在自然界中，植物生活在营养贫乏的地方，因此需要捕捉小昆虫并消化它们。膀胱陷阱是该家族的一个独特特征，挖耳草在水族箱中短暂停留后形成。该物种名称的意思是“像草一样的叶子”，新鲜的绿叶在一段时间后会形成一个漂亮的垫子，看起来像草坪（2-8 厘米高）。因此，挖耳草是一种理想的前景草，尽管它的要求相当高。

detail_list.name: Vallisneria americana 'Natans'
detail_list.introduction: Vallisneria sp. ‘Natans’ from Asia is a hardy plant for beginners. It has fine, narrow leaves (50-100 cm long, 1 cm wide) so it does not overshadow other plants much. Easy to propagate using its many runners. A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor. Remove the anchor and split into separate plants. Regarding stem plants, remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2“). Remove any damaged leaves. Plant the individual plants with some distance into the bottom substrate. Roots will develop soon and the plant start growing.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Vallisneria sp。来自亚洲的‘Natans’是一种适合初学者的耐寒植物。它的叶子又细又窄（50-100 厘米长，1 厘米宽），因此不会让其他植物黯然失色。使用其许多走茎易于传播。成束茎草或幼苗由配重环固定。取下配重环，将植株逐一分开。对于有茎草，除去最低 5 厘米（2 英寸）处的叶子。除去任何受损的叶子。将单个植物种植到底床中一定距离。植株很快会长出新根并恢复生长。

detail_list.name: Vallisneria 'Gigantea'
detail_list.introduction: Vallisneria sp. Gigantea from Asia is an easy plant that grows fast, suitable for large aquariums. In most aquariums the leaves grow so long that they float on the surface (50-150 cm, 2 cm wide). So the plant needs pruning to stop it taking too much light from plants growing beneath. The leaves are tough and strong, so they are not normally eaten by herbivorous fish. Vallisneria americana easily propagates through runners, which are prolific if the bottom is nutritious.
detail_list.introduction_cn: Vallisneria sp。来自亚洲的 Gigantea 是一种容易生长的植物，生长速度快，适合大型水族箱。在大多数水族箱中，叶子长得很长，以至于它们漂浮在水面上（50-150 厘米，2 厘米宽）。因此，植物需要修剪，以防止它从下面生长的植物那里吸收过多的光线。叶子坚韧而坚固，因此通常不会被草食性鱼类吃掉。Vallisneria americana 很容易通过走茎繁殖，如果底部营养丰富，走茎就会多产。

detail_list.name: Vallisneria spiralis 'Tiger'
detail_list.introduction: Vallisneria spiralis 'Tiger' from Asia is an excellent plant for beginners, growing in virtually all light and water conditions. The name 'Tiger' is due to its striped leaves (30-50 cm long, 1-2 cm wide). The relatively short leaves makes it suitable for small aquariums, and the leaves are also narrow, meaning they do not overshadow smaller plants. Forms runners easily, and is thus easy to propagate.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 来自亚洲的虎纹水兰是一种适合初学者的植物，几乎可以在所有光照和水分条件下生长。因其叶子呈条纹（长30-50 厘米，宽1-2 厘米）而得名“虎”。相对较短的叶子使其适合小型水族箱，而且叶子也很窄，这意味着它们不会掩盖较小的植物。容易形成走茎，因此易于繁殖。

detail_list.name: Vesicularia ferriei 'Weeping Moss'
detail_list.introduction: Vesicularia ferriei 'Weeping Moss', commonly known as Weeping Moss, is believed to originate from China and has been distributed by Oriental Aquarium Plants. 'Weeping' is a fleshy, 1-3 cm tall hanging moss with teardrop-like bright green shoots. It is best attached to driftwood or roots, as its drooping growth pattern helps to create depth and contrast in the aquarium. 'Weeping' has low demands, is fast growing and should be pruned frequently with scissors to maintain an attractive shape.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 垂泪莫丝，俗称哭泣莫丝，据信原产于中国，由东方水草经销。“哭泣”是一种肉质、1-3 厘米高的悬挂莫丝，带有泪珠状的亮绿色芽。它最好附着在沉木或沉木上，因为其下垂的生长模式有助于在水族箱中创造深度和对比度。“哭泣”要求低，生长快，应经常用剪刀修剪，以保持美观的形状。

detail_list.name: Vesicularia montagnei 'Christmas Moss'
detail_list.introduction: A moss speciality from Brasil, 1-3 cm tall, called "Christmas Moss'', because of its side branch structure which distinguishes it from ordinary Vesicularia dubyana and looks like fir tree branches. It is more demanding than ordinary Java moss and grows more slowly. It attaches readily to roots and stones, and as it spreads in the water it needs pruning to keep its shape attractive. See also Taxiphyllum barbieri.
detail_list.introduction_cn: 巴西特产莫丝，高1-3 厘米，被称为“圣诞莫丝”，因其侧枝结构与普通 Vesicularia dubyana 不同，看起来像冷杉树枝。它比普通爪哇莫丝要求更高，生长更慢。它容易附着在沉木和石材上，当它在水中蔓延时，需要修剪以保持其形状有吸引力。另见 Taxiphyllum barbieri。
